$comment: gemma-plate-views-peers-and-definitions (board SkGemmaPlaat, REQ-GPL-002): the number of inhabitants an organisation serves, so the GEMMA plate can compare it with organisations of the same type and inhabitants band (under 30,000; 30,000 to 60,000; 60,000 to 100,000; 100,000 to 250,000; above 250,000). Optional: without it, comparable falls back to the same type.

inhabitants.title: Inhabitants
inhabitants.description: The number of inhabitants the organisation serves, used to compare it with organisations of a similar size. Leave empty when it does not apply.
